senses.gloss: to judge or point out the faults and qualities of something

definition_translations.zh_TW: 評判或指出某物的缺點與品質
definition_translations.ja_JP: 物事の欠点や質を判断または指摘する

senses.gloss: to express disapproval of someone or something
senses.example: Customers criticized the airline for the long delay.

translations.th_TH: วิพากษ์วิจารณ์

example_translations.zh_TW: 顧客批評航空公司延誤太久。
example_translations.ja_JP: 顧客は長時間の遅延についてその航空会社を批判しました。
example_translations.ko_KR: 고객들은 긴 지연에 대해 그 항공사를 비판했습니다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Khách hàng đã chỉ trích hãng hàng không vì sự chậm trễ kéo dài.
